narrative: Weekend escalation in the Strait of Hormuz dominates the outlook after a projectile strike on a bulk carrier, setting up a sharp geopolitical risk premium for the Tokyo open. WTI crude's 1.42% Friday gain and persistent Iranian maritime threats likely support CAD and AUD against the USD, which closed Friday at 99.64 amid a bear steepener yield curve. USD/JPY closed Friday at 159.31 and may face downside pressure if weekend tensions trigger a flight to JPY quality, while EUR/USD (Friday close: 1.1573) remains heavy as the +143bp OIS carry advantage favors the USD ahead of September's central bank pivot points.
